versions.label: 10.3 BETA — FRIEND NOTIFY REBUILD
versions.notes: Rebuilt friend notifications. The canonical watch list is czateria_znajomi; every friend is tracked automatically with no VIP concept. Presence merges official APP rooms[] with passive live CHNS presence in open rooms. Includes warm baseline to prevent startup floods, event deduplication, 45-second purpose-driven APP state refresh, manual check/test buttons, notification history and diagnostics. No automatic code-8 friend synchronization is performed.
